title: Fix LanguageProvider Scope and Profile Synchronization Between Domains

requirements.text: Restructure the global provider hierarchy so that a single LanguageProvider wraps the entire application. The required nesting order must be: AuthProvider (InternetIdentityProvider) → LanguageProvider → Router → App. Remove any duplicate or partial LanguageProvider instances found elsewhere in the component tree. Every route — including Legal, Contact, Tokenomics, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and all other pages — must be inside this single LanguageProvider. No route or page component may call useLanguage outside of this provider scope.

quotes: Envolver TODAS as rotas dentro de LanguageProvider.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /legal, /contact, /tokenomics and all other routes produces no 'useLanguage must be used within a LanguageProvider' error in the browser console.
There is exactly one LanguageProvider instance in the entire component tree.
The LanguageProvider is a descendant of AuthProvider/InternetIdentityProvider and an ancestor of the Router and all route components.
Language switching works correctly on every page of the application.

requirements.text: Audit and enforce that all canister actor calls throughout the frontend use the hardcoded production canister IDs for Logic, Ledger, and Governance canisters. Remove any environment-switching logic that could route requests to local, dev, or mock canisters. Both quantumoney.app and quantumoneyar.app must always connect to the same production ICP mainnet canisters.

quotes: Confirmar que ambos utilizam exatamente os mesmos canisters: Logic, Ledger, Governance
Confirmar que ambos estão em ambiente production e não dev/local
Confirmar que ambos usam o mesmo backend e não mock

acceptanceCriteria: All actor/canister references in the frontend use the same hardcoded production canister IDs — no conditional dev/local/mock canister selection exists.
No mock data or simulated backend is used for profile, balance, or game state retrieval.
The same canister IDs are used regardless of which domain (quantumoney.app or quantumoneyar.app) is serving the frontend.

requirements.text: Remove any automatic profile creation logic from the frontend. If a user's Principal does not have an existing profile in the backend, the application must display a clear error or 'Profile not found' state instead of silently creating a new profile. The UserID used throughout the app must be derived solely from the authenticated Internet Identity Principal — no synthetic IDs or fallback IDs should be generated.

quotes: Remover qualquer criação automática de perfil.
Se o perfil não existir no backend principal, mostrar erro em vez de criar novo.
Garantir que ambos usam o mesmo UserID interno derivado do Principal.

acceptanceCriteria: If the authenticated Principal has no profile in the backend, the profile page shows a clear 'Profile not found' message rather than creating a new profile automatically.
No auto-registration or default profile initialization is triggered on login.
The UserID displayed and used internally is always the Internet Identity Principal — no alternate or generated ID is used.
XP, QMY balance, inventory, and game state shown in the profile are fetched from the production backend using the Principal as the key.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not introduce any new provider types or context patterns — only restructure existing ones.
All canister IDs must remain as currently defined in production — do not change canister IDs.
Do not remove or alter existing page content or UI design.
nonGoals: Changing the visual design or theme.
